content_sections.heading: About the Seed Centre Internship Programme
content_sections.text: The circular was issued on 22 October 2026 by the Director, Seed Centre, Tamil Nadu Agricultural University, Coimbatore-641 003. The internship falls under the Seed Centre's quality seed production activity, and the programme was approved by the Acting Vice-Chancellor, TNAU, Coimbatore on 20 August 2026. The selected Interns will work on a contractual service basis under the ICAR-MSP-Revolving Fund scheme operating at the Seed Centre.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: M.Sc. (Ag) and Ph.D. graduates of Seed Science and Technology Departments of TNAU. Interest in organizing seed production and marketing. Proficiency in computer application skills (MS Office and IT tools). Preference will be given to candidates possessing an entrepreneurship skill development attitude. All certificates in original in support of qualification should be produced at the time of interview. The age limit is not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility for the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Stipend: Rs.30,000/p.m. Modality of payment shall be as per the norms fixed under the programme. The position is purely temporary for the period of 8 months, on a contractual service basis. An undertaking shall be signed by the Interns selected, regarding the responsibilities of Interns and modalities of the payment of stipend.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TNAU Intern
content_sections.text: Obtain the prescribed application form from the Office of the Dean, Centre for Students Welfare, TNAU, Coimbatore on payment of Rs.30/-. Fill in the prescribed application form and attach the relevant certificates. Submit the application on or before 9.00 am on 12 November 2026. Report for the walk-in interview by 10.00 am on 12 November 2026 at the Office of the Director, Seed Centre, TNAU, Coimbatore. Bring all certificates in original in support of qualification for the interview. The notice does not mention the place where the filled application is to be submitted. Prescribed application form Relevant certificates, attached to the application All certificates in original in support of qualification, at the time of interview

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The walk-in interview consists of a written test and a personal interview, both on 12 November 2026 at the Office of the Director, Seed Centre, TNAU, Coimbatore. Written test: 10.00 to 11.00 am. Personal interview: 11.30 am, following the written test.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The interview does not guarantee any appointment.

faq.question: Q1. How many Intern positions are there in the TNAU Seed Centre walk-in 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 Intern positions under the Seed Entrepreneurship Development (SEED) internship programme at the Seed Centre, TNAU, Coimbatore.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the TNAU Intern application?
faq.answer: The application must be submitted on or before 9.00 am on 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. When and where is the TNAU Intern walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 12 November 2026 by 10.00 am at the Office of the Director, Seed Centre, TNAU, Coimbatore.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the TNAU Intern post?
faq.answer: The post is for M.Sc. (Ag) and Ph.D. graduates of Seed Science and Technology Departments of TNAU. Interest in organizing seed production and marketing and proficiency in computer application skills (MS Office and IT tools) are desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the stipend for the TNAU Intern?
faq.answer: The stipend is Rs.30,000/p.m., with the modality of payment as per the norms fixed under the programme.

faq.question: Q6. How much does the TNAU Intern application form cost?
faq.answer: The application form is obtained from the Office of the Dean, Centre for Students Welfare, TNAU, Coimbatore on payment of Rs.30/-.

faq.question: Q7. How are TNAU Interns selected?
faq.answer: Selection is by a written test from 10.00 to 11.00 am on 12 November 2026, followed by a personal interview at 11.30 am.

faq.question: Q8. Is the TNAU Intern position permanent?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely temporary for a period of 8 months, on a contractual service basis under the ICAR-MSP-Revolving Fund scheme.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the TNAU Intern interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview, and the interview does not guarantee any appointment.
